name: fix correction, rerun validation
command:
ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@spark 'cd ~/bonsai2/asm && python3 - <<PYEOF
s = open("tq_gemv_int.c").read()
old_doc = """ * Per group of 128 (= 4 blocks of 32):
 *   contrib = w_scale * sum_b( d_b * sum_{i in b}( trit_i * xq_i ) ) - correction
 *   correction (per call, from xq only):
 *       CS = sum_b( d_b * sum_{i in b} xq_i )   so that trit = d-1 costs nothing
 *"""
new_doc = """ * Per group of 128 (= 4 blocks of 32):
 *   contrib = w_scale * sum_b( d_b * sum_{i in b}( trit_i * xq_i ) )
 * with trit = digit - 1 in {-1,0,+1}, dotted DIRECTLY - no correction term.
 * (An earlier revision subtracted a CS correction, theorizing a digit-based
 * dot; the fork source (quants.c generic) decodes q = xi - 1 and dots with
 * no correction, and the corrected version mismatched on all 64 probe rows.
 * CS builder kept as dead code, not called by the dot.)
 *"""
assert s.count(old_doc) == 1
s = s.replace(old_doc, new_doc, 1)
old_acc = "            acc += (double)ws * ((double)sum - (double)CS[g]);"
new_acc = "            acc += (double)ws * (double)sum; (void)CS;"
assert s.count(old_acc) == 1
s = s.replace(old_acc, new_acc, 1)
open("tq_gemv_int.c", "w").write(s)
print("patched")
PYEOF
LB=~/bonsai2/llama.cpp/build/bin && gcc -O2 -DTQ_XGEMV_LIB -o tq_gemv_int tq_gemv_int.c tq_xgemv.c fwht.S -L$LB -lggml-base -lggml-cpu -Wl,-rpath,$LB -lm && taskset -c 3 ./tq_gemv_int ../models/Ternary-Bonsai-2-27B-PTQ1_0.gguf 11120992 594124800 64' 2>&1 | tail -5
